question: What failed in the last 24 hours on server-side GTM?
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="sgtm" AND (severity>=ERROR OR httpRequest.status>=500)

question: What failed in the last 24 hours on the event stream (errors, 5xx, or rejected pushes)?
What failed in the last 24 hours in the data generator (errors, 5xx, or ad-insert failures)?
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="data-generator" AND (severity>=ERROR OR httpRequest.status>=500 OR textPayload:"[ad-insert]")

question: What failed in the last 24 hours in the Claudish proxy (error events, capacity, rate limits, 4xx/5xx)?
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="claudish-proxy" AND (severity>=ERROR OR httpRequest.status>=400 OR jsonPayload.event=~"^(request_error|loop_fell_through|loop_retry_failed|loop_empty_result|loop_failed_midstream|lane_failed|capacity_ladder_exhausted|budget_threshold|capacity_no_budget|rate_limited)$")
